# Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness (agent-desktop)

DSH bundle that lets an agent **see and operate desktop apps** through
`agent-desktop`, the Vercel L

abs
CLI that reads and drives the OS accessibility tree — UI Automation on Windows,

reads and drives the OS accessibility tree — UI Automation on Windows,
AX on macOS, AT-SPI on Linux.

There is no pixel matching and no private native helper in this repository: the
plugin is a thin, ty

ped wrapper that runs `agent-desktop` commands and hands the
JSON envelope to the model.

from **Plugins → Discover**.

The plugin resolves the native binary itself (`agent-desktop-<platform>-<arch>`)
from PATH or the np

m global root. If it is somewhere else, set the config
`binPath` or the environment variable `DSH_AG

it is somewhere else, set the config
`binPath` or the environment variable `DSH_AGENT_DESKTOP_BIN`.
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `desktop_status` | Platform, permissions, surfaces, state root, latest snapshot |
| `desktop_snaps
hot` | Accessibility tree as JSON with a ref per actionable element (`-i`, `--compact`, `--skeleton`

, `--root`, surfaces) |
| `desktop_find` | Find elements by role / name / text / value / native id a

nd get refs without reading the whole tree |
| `desktop_inspect` | `get` a property or `is` test on

one ref — the cheap verification step |
| `desktop_act` | `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `f
ocus`, `select`, `toggle`, `check`, `uncheck`, `expand`, `collapse`, `scroll`, `scroll_to` on a ref

|
| `desktop_type` | Type text into a ref (stdin, UTF-8, interval support) |
| `desktop_set_value` |

Set a value directly (headless, no keystrokes) |
| `desktop_press` | Key combination such as `ctrl+

s` or `enter`, with `--app`, `--force` |
| `desktop_screenshot` | PNG of an app window or display, r

eturned as an image block |
| `desktop_clipboard` | Read / write / clear the clipboard (text up to 1

28 KiB) |
| `desktop_apps` | List running apps, launch, close |
| `desktop_windows` | List windows a

nd displays; focus, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize |
| `desktop_wait` | Wait for a durati

on, element, text, window, menu, event or notification |
| `desktop_batch` | Run several commands se
quentially in one process |

Ref semantics come from agent-desktop: `@<snapshot_id>:eN` is valid for one
snapshot only; a stale r

ef is refused (`STALE_REF` / `AMBIGUOUS_TARGET`) instead
of acting on the wrong element. Snapshot ag
ain after the UI changes.
## Headless and headed

Ref actions are semantic UI Automation calls by default: they do not move the
pointer, take focus or

use the clipboard. On Windows a few commands are physical
by nature — `type`, `double-click`, `righ

t-click`, `focus`, `drag`, `hover`,
`mouse-*` — and the CLI refuses them headless. The plugin adds `

--headed`
automatically for exactly those commands on Windows; pass `headed: false` to
observe the r

efusal, or set `preferHeaded: true` in the config to run everything
in headed mode.
## Config
`cordis.patch.yml` row config (all optional):
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `binPath` | auto | Absolute path to the agent-desktop native binary |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `6000

0` | Per-call timeout for ordinary commands |
| `snapshotTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Timeout for `deskto

p_snapshot` |
| `typeTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Timeout for `desktop_type` |
| `screenshotTimeoutMs` |

`60000` | Timeout for `desktop_screenshot` |
| `preferHeaded` | `false` | Add `--headed` to every co
mmand that accepts it |
## Security notes

Accessibility snapshots, screenshots, clipboard reads and command output can
contain private desktop

content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.
The CLI refuses destructive shell shortcuts (`al

t+f4`, `win+l`, `win+r`, …)
unless a call passes `force: true` to `desktop_press`.
## Platform support
| Platform | Requirement | API |

| Windows | Windows 10 1809+ x64/ARM64, interactive session | UI Automation |
| macOS | macOS 13+, A

ccessibility grant | AX API |
| Linux | Ubuntu 24.04+, X11 or Wayland, AT-SPI | AT-SPI |

A minimized window cannot be driven by ref actions — `desktop_windows restore`
first. Elevation boun
daries (UIPI) and the secure desktop are unreachable.
## Verification

Measured on Windows 11 with `agent-desktop` 1.2.0 (`agent-desktop-win32-x64.exe`),
`accessibility: g
ranted`, 14 tools registered. Real effects, not just envelopes:
| Check | Result |

| `desktop_status` | platform `windows`, permissions granted, 9 supported surfaces |
| `desktop_apps

launch` | `calc.exe`, `charmap.exe` and `powershell_ise.exe` started with pid |
| `desktop_windows

list` | 11 top-level windows with id, bounds, pid, focus state |
| `desktop_snapshot` | Calculator t

ree with 40 refs, `complete: true` |
| `desktop_find` | found `Plus`, `Three`, `Equals`, `Display is

10` refs without a full tree |
| `desktop_act click` | semantic `InvokePattern.Invoke`; 7, +, 3, =

produced **`Display is 10`** |
| `desktop_batch` | 5 clicks in 1009 ms, `stop_on_error`, all entries

`ok` |
| `desktop_screenshot` | PNG 1920x1032 returned as an image block |
| `desktop_set_value` |

`ValuePattern.SetValue`, `delivery: delivered_verified`, value read back |
| `desktop_type` | `SendI
nput.type_text` (`physical_synthetic`), `delivered_verified`; readback matched the exact text, then

cleared with `desktop_press` |
| `desktop_press` | `ctrl+a`, `delete`, `backspace` delivered to the

target app |
| `desktop_clipboard` | set → get round-tripped exactly, then restored to the previous

value |
| `desktop_windows minimize/restore` | minimized, then `window_restore` `delivered_verified`

|
| `desktop_apps close` | `charmap.exe` and `powershell_ise.exe` exited (`delivered_verified`) |
